Label: endemic
Definition: The ecological state of a species being unique to a defined geographic location, such as an island, nation, or other defined zone or habitat type.

Label: extinct
Definition: The ecological state of a species or population wherein all individuals are dead.
Editor note: DisjointWith extant (ECOCORE:00000072) — keep DisjointClasses axiom in ecocore-edit.owl.

Label: indigenous
Definition: The ecological state of a species living in a region where its presence is the result of only natural process, with no human intervention.

Label: introduced
Definition: The ecological state of a species living outside its native distributional range, which has arrived there by human activity, either deliberate or accidental.

Label: extant
Definition: The ecological state of a species or population wherein at least some individuals are alive.
Editor note: DisjointWith extinct (ECOCORE:00000069) — keep DisjointClasses axiom in ecocore-edit.owl.

Label: cosmopolitan
Definition: The ecological state of a species being found across all or most of the world in appropriate habitats.

Label: microendemic
Definition: The ecological state of a species being unique to a very small and specific location, such as the side of a mountain or a single lake.
